hybrid.reason: CREATE_NOTE/CREATE_TASK default their timestamp to the current time (a spec has no clock); CREATE_ASSOCIATIONS fans one input object out per id in `to_object_ids`. Both are runtime logic, not request shape, so they stay in the compiled adapter.
